components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 0; background: oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.145 0 0) 88%, oklch(1 0 0)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.145 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Hairline, transparent fill, ink text. Radius 0.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(0.145 0 0 / 45%); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.145 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav link
components.description: Mono from 1280. Quiet until current. Current page uses a hairline under the word.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

narrative.overview: The site is a technical document that names one file and shows its measured structure. True-black dark, paper light, radius 0, Archivo plus JetBrains Mono. The home figure comes from the SECTIONS registry. The fingerprint mark lives only in favicon and OG.
keyCharacteristics: Dark html.dark by default on true black, light html via the header switch.
One reading axis. H1, one sentence, two buttons, then the structure figure.

rules.name: The Filename-Is-The-Display Rule
rules.body: The H1 is the product name. Do not add a kicker above it.

rules.name: The Hairline-Or-Space Rule
rules.body: Pick a border or a gap. Do not stack both to fake a card.

rules.name: The Pointing-Line Rule
rules.body: Every line points at something, bounds something, or separates something. If you can remove a line without losing information, remove it.

rules.name: No accent color
rules.body: There is no accent color in the interface. The only color in the project is the fingerprint ring gradient.

dos: Do keep the home lede as One open Markdown file that teaches any AI your voice.
Do generate the home figure from SECTIONS.
Do cut a sentence rather than add a section.
donts: Don't mention AGENTS.md on home or load. FAQ and the spec may.
Don't restore zinc HSL 240 10% tokens or hsl(var(.
Don't restore preset b2YPlg or action green or DM Sans.
Don't nest cards or add a Why essay.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above the H1.
Don't put the fingerprint in the header.
Don't add a generator, loader, account, or Supervised/Jeroen branding.
